verdict.rationale: First-party SES docs state that you can send email using an AWS SDK alongside the SMTP interface and direct API calls, so building against official SDKs is a documented path. The evidence is only a brief mention, though. Missing for 10: list of supported SDK languages, SDK-specific reference docs or code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can send email from Amazon EC2 by using an AWS SDK, by using the Amazon SES SMTP interface, or by making calls directly to the Amazon SES API.
you can send email from Amazon EC2 by using an AWS SDK
